brief: A PLA post 15 mm across and 40 mm tall on a 40 mm square base 5 mm thick, centred. The whole part must be no taller than 50 mm. It carries no load, so there is no load case.

intent.summary: A simple decorative or positional PLA post mounted centrally on a square base plate, explicitly stated to carry no load.
stated: Post is centred on the base
Overall part height must be no more than 50 mm
Carries no load, no load case
implied: Post height (40mm) + base thickness (5mm) = 45mm, which fits under the 50mm overall limit, so the stack-up is consistent with the stated max height
Since centred on a square base with no other orientation cue, the post is likely a cylinder or square post standing perpendicular to the base face
Being PLA and load-free, this is likely a 3D-printed fixture, prop, spacer, or display stand rather than a structural or functional mechanical component
unstated: Whether the post is cylindrical, square, or another cross-section ('15 mm across' does not specify shape)
Any fillet or draft at the post-to-base junction
Surface finish or printing orientation requirements
Tolerances on the 15 mm, 40 mm, 40 mm, and 5 mm dimensions
Whether the base has mounting holes or other features for attachment to another surface
Any functional purpose for the post (e.g., does it need to hold or align another part, despite 'no load')
Color or infill requirements for the PLA print
Whether 'no load' includes handling/assembly forces or only in-service forces
out_of_scope: Specific dimensions beyond what was stated

requirements.statement: The finished part shall be 40 mm across in X, set by the square base.
requirements.rationale: The base (40 mm square) is wider than the 15 mm post, so it governs the part's X extent.

requirements.statement: The finished part shall be 40 mm across in Y, set by the square base.
requirements.rationale: The base (40 mm square) is wider than the 15 mm post, so it governs the part's Y extent, matching X since the base is square.

requirements.statement: The whole part shall be no taller than 50 mm overall.
requirements.rationale: Brief explicitly caps overall height at 50 mm; actual stack-up (40 mm post + 5 mm base = 45 mm) satisfies this but the stated cap is the checkable requirement.

requirements.statement: The post shall be 15 mm across.
requirements.rationale: Brief states the post is 15 mm across.

requirements.statement: The post shall stand 40 mm tall above the base.
requirements.rationale: Brief states the post is 40 mm tall.

requirements.statement: The base shall be 40 mm square.
requirements.rationale: Brief states a 40 mm square base; this single parameter drives both X and Y of the base.

requirements.statement: The base shall be 5 mm thick.
requirements.rationale: Brief states the base is 5 mm thick.

assumptions.statement: The post is cylindrical (round in cross-section), 15 mm in diameter.
assumptions.rationale: '15 mm across' is ambiguous between a round post's diameter and a square post's width; a round post is the more common reading for a standalone post feature.
assumptions.consequence_if_wrong: If the post is meant to be square or another polygon, the modeled cross-section and any roundness checks would not match the intended shape.

assumptions.statement: The part is printed in standard PLA with no specified grade, color, or infill.
assumptions.rationale: Brief states material as PLA with no further detail.
assumptions.consequence_if_wrong: Unlikely to matter since the part carries no load; only affects appearance or print settings.

assumptions.statement: The base has no mounting holes, fillets, chamfers, or other secondary features beyond the post and base block; the post-to-base junction is a sharp, unfilleted join.
assumptions.rationale: Brief describes only the post and base dimensions with no mention of additional features.
assumptions.consequence_if_wrong: If mounting holes or fillets were actually wanted, the part would need rework to add them, but this does not invalidate the base geometry.

assumptions.statement: The post is centred on the base such that the post's axis passes through the centre of the square base.
assumptions.rationale: Brief explicitly states the post is centred on the base.
assumptions.consequence_if_wrong: An off-centre post would not match the stated design intent, affecting visual/functional symmetry.

assumptions.statement: Standard FDM 3D-printing tolerances (approximately ±0.2 mm) apply to all stated dimensions; no tight tolerance is required.
assumptions.rationale: Brief gives no tolerance callouts and the part is a simple PLA print.
assumptions.consequence_if_wrong: Tighter tolerance needs would require secondary machining or a different process.

document.name: Decorative post on square base
document.description: A load-free decorative PLA post mounted centrally on a square base plate.

parameters.description: Side length of the square base plate, used for both X and Y
Height of the post above the base's top face

answer.rationale: The part is built from two primitives: a square box base (one parameter, base_side, used in both X and Y) and a cylinder post (post_diameter, post_height) standing on the base's top face at base_thickness/2 since the base is centered. The two are combined with a single union into the terminal solid; no holes or other features are needed since the brief specifies none and the post carries no load.

note: 'The whole part must be no taller than 50 mm' was read as the part's height: the record's at_most 50 became equals 50, and a correct 45 mm part -- a 40 mm post on a 5 mm base -- was given a 5 mm riser nobody asked for. The answer is the first design, before the repair added the riser.
